Fat Intake Calculator

Convert a chosen percentage of daily calories from fat into grams and show the corresponding calorie amount. This keeps the energy conversion transparent while allowing the user to select a target for comparison. Fat provides about 9 kcal per gram, so fat grams = daily calories × selected percentage ÷ 100 ÷ 9. The percentage refers to energy share, not weight share; the calculation reports total fat and does not split fatty-acid types.

How to use this calculator

  1. Enter daily calorie target, calories from fat.
  2. Select Calculate to see the answer and its breakdown.
  3. Keep a scenario, change an input and compare the results.

Use consistent units and check the assumptions below before applying the result.

How fat intake is calculated

Fat provides about 9 kcal per gram, so fat grams = daily calories × selected percentage ÷ 100 ÷ 9. The percentage refers to energy share, not weight share; the calculation reports total fat and does not split fatty-acid types. At 2,000 kcal with 30% from fat, the estimate is 600 kcal or about 66.7 g of fat.

Fat grams=calories×selected percentage/100/9.
A worked example

At 2,000 kcal with 30% from fat, the estimate is 600 kcal or about 66.7 g of fat.

Assumptions & useful context

Total fat only; the calculation does not distinguish types of fat.

Health calculations are estimates for education. They cannot diagnose a condition or replace a clinician’s assessment. Individual needs vary, especially during pregnancy, illness and growth.

Frequently asked questions

Does the result distinguish saturated and unsaturated fat?

No. It is total fat only.

Is 30% the right target for everyone?

No; the appropriate pattern depends on personal health and dietary needs.
